# Welcome to DieselDB Discussions

Welcome to the official discussion forum for DieselDB! This is the place to ask questions, share ideas, connect with other users, and engage with the development community.

## 🎯 About DieselDB

DieselDB is a production-grade Java database engine that implements modern database engineering practices including:

- **ARIES crash recovery** with full three-phase implementation
- **Segmented WAL** with group commit and async writer
- **MVCC with SSI** for Serializable isolation
- **Online schema changes** with multiple algorithms
- **PostgreSQL-compatible protocol** and drivers
- **Multiple storage backends** (in-memory, CSV, TSV, JSONL, AVRO)

## 💬 Discussion Categories

We have three main discussion categories to help organize conversations:

### 📚 Q&A (Questions)
Use this category for:
- How-to questions about using DieselDB
- Troubleshooting and debugging help
- Configuration and setup questions
- Performance optimization questions

### 💡 Ideas (Feature Requests)
Share your ideas for:
- New features and improvements
- Enhancements to existing functionality
- Integration opportunities
- Use case suggestions

### 🎉 Show & Tell (Community Stories)
Show us how you're using DieselDB:
- Success stories and case studies
- Performance benchmarks and optimizations
- Creative use cases and implementations
- Integrations with other technologies

## 🤝 Getting Help

### Before Asking
- Check the [documentation](https://reider85.github.io/dieseldb/)
- Search existing discussions first
- Review [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Reider85/dieseldb/issues) for similar problems
- Try the [Quick Start guide](https://github.com/Reider85/dieseldb#quick-start)

### When Asking a Question
Please include:
- **DieselDB version** (check `pom.xml`)
- **JDK version** and operating system
- **Storage backend** you're using (in-memory, CSV, TSV, JSONL, AVRO)
- **Exact steps to reproduce** the issue
- **Expected vs actual behavior**
- **Error messages** and logs (if any)

## 🌟 Contributing

We love community contributions! Here's how you can help:

### Good First Issues
Look for issues labeled `good first issue` and `help wanted`. These are designed for new contributors and typically take 1-2 hours to complete.

### Code Contributions
- Fork the repository
- Create a feature branch
- Add tests for your changes
- Submit a pull request
- Check our [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Reider85/dieseldb/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines

### Documentation
Help us improve the documentation by:
- Fixing typos and unclear explanations
- Adding missing examples
- Translating content to other languages
- Creating tutorials and guides
